sn35.122:1.1: Saṃyojaniye ca bhikkhave dhamme desissāmi saṃyojanañ ca ||
sn35.122:1.3: Katame ca bhikkhave saṃyojaniyā dhammā katamaṃ saṃyojanaṃ || || 3
sn35.122:1.4: Santi bhikkhave cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmupasaṃhitā rajanīyā ||
sn35.122:1.6: Yo tattha chandarāgo taṃ tattha saṃyojanaṃ || || 4-7
sn35.122:1.7: Santi bhikkhave sotaviññeyyā saddā || || Ghānaviññeyyā gandhā || || Jivhāviññeyyā rasā || || Kāyaviññeyyā poṭṭhabbā || || 8
sn35.122:1.8: Santi bhikkhave manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā ||
sn35.122:1.9: ime vuccanti bhikkhave bhikkhave saṃyojaniyā dhammā || ||
